findings.why: BR-310 belongs to PRG-Y, which belongs to Nordhavn. Changing the coating from COAT-TCP to COAT-CCC-YELLOW needs written Nordhavn approval before the first shipment. No deviation or approval in force covers this change. DEV-125 only covers packing.

findings.why: SUP-C is the source of BR-310. SUP-C has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material, which is the alloy of BR-310 (6082-T5), and the 8D was raised on BR-310 itself. The re-audit restored SUP-C's company status but did not close the 8D.
